loss: 0.5 unchanged BCE + 0.5 soft Dice over GT-positive image/class pairs only; smoothing=1; empty batch Dice term=0
train_sampling: one sample per source image; choose its rarest present class by training image count, then a uniform native grid patch containing that class; negatives keep uniform grid sampling
selection: highest full native-resolution validation macro Dice at threshold 0.5; first epoch wins ties
